multiple_tags.observed: Named disposable reference task displays multiple tag chips; two formal test tags appear in the sidebar.
multiple_tags.current_reference_tag_board_duplication_: Not dynamically confirmed; cross-column duplication is the implemented design, verified in WorkFollow.

remaining_reference_checks: Editing permissions inside an archived list.
Exact tag-grouping duplication and cross-column drag rules.

implementation: Add optional archive date to list metadata and preserve identity, organization, tasks and existing reminder settings.
Archive/restore through one undoable metadata commit, including undo/redo reminder eligibility notifications.
Show a foldable archived list group and direct browsing with restore controls; exclude archive from active projections and target pickers.
Persist all list names, including empty archives, through SQLite and migration export/import.
Clear stale saved-filter selection when navigating into a normal or archived list.
Project multi-tag tasks into each kanban tag column with one shared task identity, hierarchy and action stream; preserve unique flat-list rows.
skip_reasons: Four meeting integrations require explicitly enabled real Pi services.
One anchored property-panel focus test requires the temporary XCTest host to become the active app.
